title: NPDev browser-AI relay: session
description: One conversation between the user's browser AI and NPDev, persisted as session.json in <relay root>/<code>/, where <relay root> is the same per-user NPDev folder npdev_ai_config.mine_path() lives in, plus 'ai-relay' (never a hard-coded path). Layout: session.json, round-<n>/prompt.txt, round-<n>/answer-raw.txt (+ received files), round-<n>/result.json (an ai-relay-ingest-result), transcript.jsonl.

language.description: Human language name put in the prompt, from the Manager's language (D-8), e.g. 'Portuguese (Brazil)'.

appDir.description: null for intent=create until apply creates the app.

newAppName.description: intent=create: the folder name the user chose.

baseModelSha256.description: sha256 of model.json when the session started (change/fix). Differs at apply time -> merge S5 or refuse with a plain message.

knowledgeSha256.description: contentSha256 of the compact bundle used (build_core_context manifest).

answerSize.description: How long an answer the person asked for (new apps only): small, medium or large (a share of the chosen AI's answer budget) or a number of characters. Absent = automatic: no size is stated in the prompt.

trail.description: One line per failed round (error signature), fed to fresh-chat prompts and used to detect going in circles.
